title: Air Force retires iconic Huey helicopters as Black Hawks take over

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Air Force (PAF) has retired its last six operational UH-1H helicopters after newer Black Hawks took over most of their transport and disaster-response missions.
